bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
git fetch --no-tags origin dfecd210114b4c54b9c62fba54a81a40089c2a55
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = dfecd210114b4c54b9c62fba54a81a40089c2a55
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,tempfile,sys
old="623596150985274a59e9336b7e45eeb8d65f76d7";new="dfecd210114b4c54b9c62fba54a81a40089c2a55"
p=Path("scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py")
if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():raise RuntimeError("ACTIVATION_STAGING_NOT_FOUND")
previous=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{old}:scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py"])
if p.read_bytes()!=previous:raise RuntimeError("STAGED_ACTIVATION_HASH_CHANGED")
source=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{new}:scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py"])
compile(source.decode(),str(p),"exec")
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".activate-public-",dir=str(p.parent))
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as out:out.write(source)
 os.chmod(tmp,0o644)
 os.replace(tmp,p)
finally:
 if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from userbot_public_video_activate_all import compose_updates
files=compose_updates(new)
print("ALL_HISTORY_SOURCE_PREFLIGHT=PASS")
print("PATCHED_MODULE_COUNT="+str(len(files)))
PY
if systemctl --user list-units --all --no-legend 'gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service' | grep -q gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114; then echo FULL_HISTORY_ALREADY_LAUNCHED;exit 77;fi
systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py --source-commit dfecd210114b4c54b9c62fba54a81a40089c2a55
echo PUBLIC_VIDEO_ALL_JOINED_JOB=STARTED
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager
